messages:
Maya (docs): Heads-up — I'm drafting the release summary for next Wednesday's docs deploy. Need the final SDK snippet migration plan + a concise known-issues list. Can folks chime in with blockers? :wave:

Jonas (eng): Quick note: runtime changed prefix caching behavior in canary yesterday. Apps that relied on aggressive prefix cache may see slightly higher initial latency. I can add a short explainer paragraph and a link to the runtime changelog.

Tim (sdk): I'm updating examples in python/js. Heads-up on one API rename: we changed `max_tokens` -> `token_limit` in the new client. I'll swap examples and add a one-line compatibility note.

Sandeep (devex): For migration steps I suggest: 1) `compat` snippet showing old->new param 2) snippet for streaming fallback 3) a small CI test we can drop into repo to catch `token_limit` regressions. Short and copy-pasteable.

Maya (docs): Good. Can you paste the compat snip here so I can copy it into the relnotes? I want something tiny, one-liner.

Tim (sdk): Sure — here's a tiny patch example:

```bash
# replace old param in codebases (one-off)
# WARNING: run in a branch
find . -name '*.py' -exec sed -i 's/max_tokens/token_limit/g' {} +
```

Jonas (eng): Also calling out: embed streaming can sometimes drop a token when using the legacy web-socket shim. Known issue — reproducible on models < 2.1. I'll add repro steps and a mitigation (use http streaming until patched).

Li (product): Keep the relnotes customer-facing. One short bullet about "improved caching behavior" + a separate technical note for the docs page with the fallback/mitigation link. Product wants the first line to be: "Reduced steady-state latency for long-context workloads; initial warm-up may be slightly longer for some apps."

Maya (docs): ok will use that exact sentence. For the docs page I want a small "If you see regressions" subsection with the commands above and a link to the runtime changelog. Any objections?

Sandeep (devex): No objections. Also recommend we add a quick test snippet for CI: something that calls the SDK with both `max_tokens` and `token_limit` to verify backward compat. I can PR that test in the sdk-examples repo.

Tim (sdk): PR incoming — #4321. DocsBot: created PR "sdk: compat test for token param" by Tim — https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/4321 :white_check_mark:

DocsBot: deploy-bot: staging docs build started for branch `release/docs-2026-03-xx` — logs: https://ci.internal/builds/9999

Maya (docs): Perfect. Action items: Tim -> update snippets + open PR (tracking #4321), Jonas -> write runtime changelog paragraph + repro steps, Sandeep -> PR for CI test, Li -> approve customer-facing blurb. I'll assemble relnotes and ping for final review by EOD Friday.

Li (product): Approved. LGTM.

Jonas (eng): I'll drop the repro steps in this thread in the morning and paste the runtime link.

Maya (docs): thanks all — I'll post the draft relnote here when it's ready for quick copy-edit. :memo:
